story: Toltec Mounds Archeological State Park is an archaeological site located in Arkansas, USA. It protects an 18-mound complex with the tallest surviving prehistoric mounds in Arkansas, situated on the banks of Mound Lake.
matters: The site is designated as a National Historic Landmark and was occupied from the 7th to the 11th century by indigenous ancestors of regional Native Americans.
name: Toltec Mounds Archeological State Park
